responsibility: Declares the D front end’s main declaration hierarchy and storage-class model. It defines the bitmask constants for D/ImportC declaration attributes and the core symbol classes for variables, functions, constructors, destructors, static constructors/destructors, invariants, unittests, `new` overloads, and related declaration forms, supplying the semantic and ABI-facing metadata that later passes use for type checking, overload resolution, contract handling, nested-frame analysis, and code generation setup.
